record.one_liner: Cloud web-based help desk and shared inbox for support teams, with AI agents and a built-in MCP server
record.auth_notes: Public API v3 and legacy v1 each use a separate API key, created under Configuration > System > API (v3) or the API v1 settings section. The MCP server uses OAuth 2.1 for AI clients, but that is not the public REST API auth path.
record.access_notes: critic: confirmed self_serve_trial. Pricing page FAQ says every plan starts with a 30-day free trial, no credit card required; no free plan (plans from $15 per agent per month).
record.api_notes: Two API versions: v1 is deprecated but functional and v3 is current. Endpoint-level breadth not verified on a fetched API reference page.
record.blocker_notes: critic: trial length now confirmed (30 days, no card). Credentials are self-serve and the API is documented; a paid plan is needed after the trial but does not block building.
